scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .build-ssr && node tools/prerender.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src content tools/*.mjs package.json components.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html 404.html wrangler.jsonc README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src content tools/*.mjs package.json components.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html 404.html wrangler.jsonc README.md
